title: Object Storage: outage claim — recorded outcome
content:
For Object Storage outage claim, the customer files the additional entitlement as a nonnegative claimed amount, rounded half-up to the tier monetary precision; the tool records notice filing time from the current handling clock immediately.

## Basis Q&A

What determines outage claim in this situation? The customer files the additional entitlement as a nonnegative claimed amount, rounded half-up to the tier monetary precision; the tool records notice filing time from the current handling clock immediately.

## Hypothetical outage claim amount

Assume hypothetical additional entitlement of USD 16.25. The customer filing states USD 16.25 as a nonnegative claim, and the filing time is the current handling time.
